description: Check whether the current state meets the task's goal conditions: passed plus one met/unmet entry per condition with its sentence and formal form, the same check a human player gets. Argument: expectedRevision (the current revision); optional lang. Checking changes nothing on the board. If observe shows limits.checks, each check uses one (checksRemaining says how many are left) and a used-up limit is refused with check_budget_exhausted.
name: check_result
